drills.title: Five-Spot Form Shooting
drills.instructions: Shoot from five comfortable spots. Reset your feet and hold your follow-through after each shot.
drills.visualSummary: Five positions, balanced release, held follow-through
sequence: Reset feet at a comfortable spot
Hold the follow-through at the spot

comparison.note: Balanced finish versus drifting off the spot and dropping the follow-through.

drills.title: Catch, Set, Shoot
drills.instructions: Start balanced at a comfortable spot, gently self-toss, catch, set both feet, square to the hoop and shoot. Retrieve the ball safely and reset.
drills.videoQuery: basketball catch and shoot shooting drill

comparison.note: Balanced catch-and-set versus a rushed, off-balance catch.

drills.title: Move Into Midrange
drills.instructions: Start at a wing, make a controlled change of direction, stop under control, then shoot.
drills.target: Complete 10 balanced attempts from both sides.
drills.visualSummary: Wing change-of-direction into a balanced jumper

comparison.note: Controlled stop versus sideways drift or crossed feet.

drills.title: Stationary Crossover Control
drills.instructions: Stay in an athletic stance and cross the ball below your waist. Keep your eyes up and use a controlled pace.
drills.visualSummary: Low stationary crossover with eyes up

comparison.note: Low controlled dribble versus a high, exposed crossover with eyes down.

drills.title: Change-of-Pace Lane
drills.instructions: Dribble from baseline to half court slowly, accelerate for a few steps, then decelerate under control.
drills.videoQuery: basketball change of pace dribbling drill
drills.visualSummary: Slow baseline dribble, short burst, controlled deceleration

comparison.note: Eyes-up control versus an upright, high loose dribble.

drills.title: Combo Into Drive
drills.instructions: Combine two controlled moves, protect the ball, then accelerate toward an open lane. Keep the space clear.
drills.target: Complete 8 clean combinations on each hand.
drills.visualSummary: Two protected moves into an open driving lane
sequence: Protect the ball through the combo

comparison.note: Ball kept close versus unnecessarily exposed outside the body.

drills.title: Right and Left Layups
drills.instructions: Approach at a comfortable speed, use the correct footwork, and finish gently off the backboard with each hand.
drills.videoQuery: basketball right left hand layup drill

comparison.reason: The plate contrasts right- and left-hand layup patterns; it does not show a reliable common-mistake comparison.

drills.title: Change Direction Finish
drills.instructions: Approach a cone or court line, change direction without slipping, and finish with the hand farthest from the imaginary defender.
drills.visualSummary: Controlled direction change into a far-hand finish
sequence: Finish with the hand farthest from the imaginary defender

comparison.note: Far-hand protection versus exposing the ball with the near hand.

drills.title: Reverse Finish Footwork
drills.instructions: Practice the path under the basket at a controlled pace. Protect the ball and finish on the far side of the rim.
drills.target: Complete 6 controlled reverse layups per side.
drills.visualSummary: Protected path under the basket to a far-side finish
sequence: Protect the ball under the hoop
Finish gently on the far side

comparison.note: Far-side finish versus stopping on the near side.

drills.title: Defensive Slide Intervals
drills.instructions: Stay balanced with knees bent. Slide without crossing your feet, then rest and reset. Use a dry, non-slippery surface.
drills.target: 4 rounds of 20 seconds with 20 seconds rest.
drills.visualSummary: Balanced lateral slides with reset intervals

comparison.note: Feet apart during the slide versus crossed feet.

drills.title: Closeout and Contest
drills.instructions: Choose an imaginary shooter spot on a dry clear court. Mark a stopping point outside the imagined landing area. Approach under control, shorten your steps, raise your hands and stop balanced without jumping forward.
drills.visualSummary: Controlled closeout with a visible no-contact buffer
sequence: Raise hands and stop without contact

comparison.reason: A wrong closeout image could normalize contact or entering a shooter's landing space; the plate shows safe spacing instead.

drills.title: Mirror Footwork
drills.instructions: Mark left, center and right positions on a dry clear court. Imagine an opponent moving between them; alternate lateral slides and controlled direction changes for 30 seconds. Reset at center and stop if balance is lost.
drills.visualSummary: Partner mirror steps at safe distance
sequence: Stop and reset if balance is lost

comparison.note: Safe spacing versus crowding and crossing feet, without contact.

drills.title: Box-Out Footwork
drills.instructions: Find the ball, turn toward the opponent's path, establish legal position without pushing, then locate the rebound.
drills.visualSummary: Find the ball, establish legal position, locate the rebound
sequence: Turn into legal position without pushing
Find the rebound after holding position

comparison.reason: The generated lower inset depicted forearm contact and was cropped before bundling; the safe sequence remains.

drills.title: Secure and Outlet
drills.instructions: Jump only when safe, secure the ball with two hands, land balanced, pivot, and make a controlled outlet pass.
drills.visualSummary: Safe two-hand rebound, balanced landing, controlled outlet
sequence: Jump only when space is safe
Secure with two hands and land balanced
Pivot, then make a controlled outlet

comparison.note: Balanced two-hand control versus an unstable one-hand recovery.

drills.title: Solo Shot and Rebound
drills.instructions: Take a comfortable shot on a clear court. Track the ball, move into a safe rebound position, secure it with both hands and reset.
drills.visualSummary: Read a partner shot and rebound outside the landing area
sequence: Read the bounce and move safely
Secure the rebound and alternate roles

comparison.reason: A negative example could imply entering the shooter's landing area; the plate shows safe spacing only.

drills.title: Target Chest and Bounce Passes
drills.instructions: Choose a sturdy permitted wall with clear space. Aim chest passes at a chest-height mark; bounce passes at a floor point that sends the ball to a waist-height wall mark. Control the return and reset.
drills.target: Complete 10 accurate passes of each type.
sequence: Use a chest or bounce pass
Send the bounce to the floor point that reaches waist height

comparison.reason: The plate compares two valid pass types, not a common mistake.

drills.title: Pass and Cut
drills.instructions: Use a sturdy permitted wall and a clear lateral lane. Make a gentle pass toward a wall target angled to return into the lane, take a short lateral cut, show your hands and control the return. Reset if the bounce is unpredictable.
drills.visualSummary: Pass, cut into space, show hands, receive
sequence: Show hands and receive under control

comparison.note: Cutting after the pass versus standing still.

drills.title: Rebound Outlet Decisions
drills.instructions: Choose two reachable targets on a sturdy permitted wall with clear passing lanes. Secure a gentle self-toss as a simulated rebound, scan both targets, pivot without traveling and pass to an open target. Control the return before resetting.
drills.visualSummary: Secure, scan, pivot legally, and outlet to an open lane
sequence: Choose a clear lane and pass

comparison.note: Planted pivot foot versus lifting the pivot foot.
